nodes.g: Naomi = "my delight" wife of Elimelech, mother of Mahlon and Chilion, and mother-in-law…
nodes.bdb: Naomi = "my delight" wife of Elimelech, mother of Mahlon and Chilion, and mother-in-law of Ruth and Orpah

nodes.g: Mahlon = "sick" son of Elimelech by Naomi and first husband of Ruth
Elimelech = "my God is king" Naomi's husband
Ruth = "friendship" daughter-in-law of Naomi, wife of Boaz, and grandmother of David
Orpah = "gazelle" a Moabite woman, wife of Chilion, the son of Naomi, and sister-in- law…
Boaz = "fleetness" ancestor of David, kinsman-redeemer to Ruth, daughter-in-law of Naomi…
